title: $k$-Fibonacci and $k$-Lucas numbers with the Hölder inequality
summary: Dujella, Jak\v setić and Pe\v carić recently established in \cite{DJP}, a chain of power-sum inequalities, built from Hölder's and Cauchy's inequalities and their converse forms, and applied it to the Fibonacci sequence using the identities $\sum_{i=1}^nF_i^2=F_nF_{n+1}$ and $\sum_{i=1}^nF_iF_{i+1}=F_{n+1}^2-\frac{1+(-1)^n}{2}$. We show that this machinery applies uniformly across the one-parameter family of $k$-Fibonacci and $k$-Lucas numbers of Falcón and Plaza, via the generalized identities \begin{align*} \sum_{i=1}^nL_{k,i}^2=\frac{L_{k,n}L_{k,n+1}-2k}{k},\qquad…
